tagline: A band that plays exotic grooves mixed with danceable beats.
bandLead: We share a hip set of pieces from Africa, America, and places in between.
bandText: Under the leadership of the drummer, George, Mixed Roots is a rare breed of band. Its members come from different places and now call Albany, New York home. Together, the band plays with energy that comes from their mixed roots, and they are excited to share their styles with you.

lineup.name: George
lineup.bio: Grew up in Accra, Ghana, learning traditional African beats, and shares his vocabulary of AfroBeat and reggae.

lineup.name: Gideon
lineup.bio: Melts the keys with chordal structures influenced by his Nigerian upbringing.

lineup.name: Seth
lineup.bio: Showing his Ghanaian roots, he drives danceable beats on the hand drums.

lineup.name: Brian
lineup.bio: Plays with several upstate New York reggae groups and brings flavors from the Grateful Dead and others.

lineup.name: Pete
lineup.bio: Decades of playing reggae, rock, and all places in between.

lineup.name: Dillon & Catherine
lineup.bio: The horn section adds local flavor while keeping respect for their worldly interests.

bookingText: Venues, festivals, private parties, community events. Send inquiries to the band; we'd love to hear from you!
